title: Introducing India-based inference for Kimi K3 on Amazon Bedrock
summary: Amazon Bedrock now offers in-country inference in India for Kimi K3, keeping processing within the Mumbai and Hyderabad Regions. This post explains the global and geographic cross-Region inference options and shares example code for reading and understanding Indic-language docume
reason: AWS Bedrock regional inference availability for the existing Kimi K3 model is an infrastructure/geographic deployment update, not a new model, major version, or new capability; it also does not match research, industry business events, policy, or OSS tooling rules.
